description.text: This major can be taught in English, and the tuition will be RMB 40,000 per year.

duration.text: The Signal and Information Processing at Dalian University of Technology is a 5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese/English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4583 USD/per year ￥ 33000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.HSK Certificate No need for English taught programs 2. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 3.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 4.Transcript of postgraduate school 5.Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 6.Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents.

requirements.text: 1. Hold a master diploma 2. Be in good health 3. Within the age bracket of 18-45 years old (students under 18 years old only can apply if you have guarantor in China) 4. With a Chinese proficiency level of HSK 5 or above (HSK 7 for Arts students) 5. On passing the exams set by the university in accordance with the program chosen, the applicants can be admitted to do a bachelor's degree program at the university.
